results.note: Quaestiones super Exodum — no English translation found. Not included in published Bede translations.
Quaestiones super Genesim — no English translation found. Not included in 'Bede: A Biblical Miscellany' or other published collections.
Quaestiones super Leviticum — no English translation found in published sources.
Quaestiones super Numeros — no English translation found.

Quaestiones super libros Regum = 'Thirty Questions on the Book of Kings' — English translation by Trent W. Foley & Arthur G. Holder in 'Bede: A Biblical Miscellany' (Liverpool University Press, Translated Texts for Historians, 1999).
Quaestiones super librum Jesu Nave (Joshua) — no English translation found.
Quaestiones super librum Judicum (Judges) — no English translation found.
Quaestiones super librum Ruth — no English translation found.
Sermo in Psalmum LII — no complete English translation found. Referenced on Wikisource Latin but no modern English translation located.
Carmina dubia — no English translation of this Bede-attributed poetry found. Likely spurious attribution per modern scholarship.
De VII verbis Christi in cruce — no English translation found under this attribution. Arnold of Bonneval wrote on this topic but this specific attribution differs.
De meditatione passionis Christi per VII horas diei — identified as Pseudo-Bede text but no English translation found. Different from the more widely translated 'Meditationes Vitae Christi.'

De officiis — attribution is 'Auctor incertus (Beda?).' Ambrose wrote a famous 'De officiis' with modern English translation by Ivor J. Davidson (Oxford, 2002), but unclear if this is the same work or a different attribution.
De remediis peccatorum — no English translation found. Different from Petrarch's more famous 'De remediis utriusque fortunae.'
De urbe Roma — no English translation found in published sources.
De urbe Treverensium — no English translation found.
Dionysius de annis — medieval Latin text on chronological and calendrical calculations found on Wikisource, but no English translation located.
Epigramma de B. Joanne et ejus Apocalypsi — no English translation found.
Excerptiones (CPL 1129 — Collectanea/Flores ex diversis) — no English translation found. Likely spurious attribution per modern CCSL scholarship.
VI formulae orationis — no English translation found. Uncertain whether this is a named medieval text or a generic title.
